{{Quote|Need advice, I'm your guy.|Jonos Triv|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Jonos Triv''' was a [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who worked as a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. While on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], he frequented the Senate Commercial District where he would spend his time at the [[Drunkard's Vote]] cantina.
